description: Use this when you want data from another paid API without handling its invoice: pay ONE BitTuitive invoice (sats, or the same all-in price in USDC via x402) and BitTuitive pays the upstream, calls it and returns its JSON in `data` plus `routing` (upstream, score, fee). Pass capability and optional prefer (recommended), or endpoint_id / data_type / q (legacy). Never returns the upstream URL. fallback. Cost: upstream price + routing fee max(20%, 3 sats). Side effect: spends your payment on the upstream call; if every upstream fails you get a 24h credit token to pass as `credit`. If the result is status 'running', repeat the identical call to collect it. Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Example: call_routed_api(data_type="bitcoin", q="mempool fees") Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed routed call (instead of paying).

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

params.description: Optional query parameters forwarded to the upstream API.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: call_routed_api
title: Call any verified data API through BitTuitive (sats or USDC)
